notes.title: Announcement of the game "RUSSIAN SOUL SIMULATOR"
notes.content:
Greetings players!
Announcing one more of our meditative games in Russian setting - "RUSSIAN SOUL SIMULATOR"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2734520

[b][i]Russian Soul Simulator[/i] is a meditative game that allows the player to look at the Russian nature and the surrounding world in realistic graphics. The game allows the protagonist to move freely through fields and forests, explore the surrounding terrain and interact with various objects.[/b]

Game trailer:
[previewyoutube=HTux9EhV34o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Add the game to your wishlists![/h1]
